description.value: Farros Pizza and Greek is a Kamloops restaurant offering an eclectic menu that combines Greek classics, wood-fired pizzas, and Indian dishes from two city locations. The Tranquille Road outpost (Unit 10) is one of the pair, with the menu spanning souvlaki, Greek ribs, calamari, and paneer tikka. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, handcrafted and fully customizable dishes, with the Family Pack — loaded with skewers, ribs, prawns, calamari, and sides — as the house favourite.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Farros Pizza & Greek operates two Kamloops locations, with the OSM address (Unit 10, 1800 Tranquille Rd, V2B 3L9) explicitly corroborated. The site features prominent 'Order Now' buttons indicating takeout/online ordering, and the menu lists Paneer Tikka as a vegetarian dish, confirming at least one vegetarian option. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Farros Pizza and Greek' but the website consistently uses 'Farros Pizza & Greek' (ampersand vs. 'and').
Phone number (+1 778 470 2929) appears in OSM but is not visible in the fetched website content, so it could not be confirmed or contradicted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with active website, confirmed two-location presence in Kamloops, and online ordering — useful refuelling stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Paneer Tikka ('marinated cheese cooked with green peppers, tomatoes in hot clay oven') — a vegetarian dish — and Greek salad
